questionnaire.Where does the story take place?: a busy college campus that hides a secret rooftop garden
questionnaire.Who is the supporting character?: Dev, Arjun's best friend who wears glasses
questionnaire.What challenge does the hero face?: Their laptop dies the night before the big project is due and they blow up at each other, each blaming the other
questionnaire.How does the hero overcome the challenge: After sulking apart they cool off, laugh at how silly the fight was and finish it together on an old library computer
questionnaire.What lesson does the story teach?: good friends turn disasters into adventures
questionnaire.Any special details to include?: Arjun's brown-and-white zip jacket and Dev's navy t-shirt and glasses
